description: Creating Resilient Water Utilities - Storm Surge Inundation Map is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA Creating Resilient Water Utilities Program. This map displays the potential for flooding in coastal areas based on hurricane surge models and FEMA flood zones. This map also displays real-time storms and flood advisories to help utilities identify the potential for hurricane landfall and coastal flooding. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Landslides. Assets: Water Infrastructure – Stormwater, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
